text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both treading water with minor losses, suggesting neither momentum nor conviction behind current price levels. Extreme Fear sentiment (25) and declining Fear & Greed trend indicate sustained pessimism, though the $63B daily volume is moderate rather than panicked. Bitcoin's dominance at 56.4% combined with modest outperformance by altcoins like BNB hints that traders are hedging exposure rather than rotating decisively into alts.
